current_interpretation: Permit package documents are inventoried in document_inventory.json by filename, document_kind, byte size, and sha256 hash. construction.py maps them to permit_document (12 rows) without ingesting body text. The draft declares permit_document_text_not_available as EXPLICIT_UNRESOLVED and does not rank document kinds (for example final_permit vs fact_sheet vs statement_of_basis) as authoritative from filenames alone.
why_it_matters: Purposes B and C may depend on narrative permit conditions—discharge triggers, seasonal requirements, special studies—that are not represented in structured CSV fields. Without document text or an agreed authority hierarchy, those conditions cannot be established from the available evidence.
supporting_evidence_used: construction.py (permit_document mapping and permit_document_text_not_available unresolved declaration)
alternatives_considered: Treat final_permit document_kind as authoritative over fact_sheet, statement_of_basis, and supporting documents based on filename alone
Treat all inventoried documents as equally non-authoritative without text (current draft choice)
Use document_kind only to prioritize which file to fetch for human review, without asserting World-true conditions
affected_computations: Purpose B monitoring obligations that depend on narrative permit conditions
Purpose C missing-evidence cases that may require permit narrative context
remaining_uncertainty: Which document would be authoritative if text were present; whether filename kinds imply hierarchy.
